name: ajani-workforce-platform
description: Ajani Workforce, a pre-production healthcare workforce product from Ajani Healthcare.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build --workspace @ajani/contracts && npm run build --workspace @ajani/database
scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @ajani/contracts && npm run build --workspace @ajani/database
scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:database && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:database && npm run build --workspace @ajani/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:database && npm run typecheck --workspace @ajani/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @ajani/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @ajani/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @ajani/web && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:database && npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run check:bundle
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run db:verify
